none: PAS HAMP-C77A14: Roman samian ware bowl (form 18/31)
contea di ritrovamento: Hampshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A vessel sherd representing approximately half of the floor of a Roman Samian ware bowl. The sherd is convex, typical of the floors of Form 18/31 bowls. The fabric has a dark red-orange slip. On the lower surface is a basal ring (Th.: c. 8mm) whose diameter can be estimated at c. 100mm. Within this are concentric circles from the manufacturing process. There is a loss to the side of the ring.…
